title: Disney Announces New Shopping Experiences and Exclusive Merchandise Available to Fans at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event
summary: Disney unveiled exclusive shopping experiences and merchandise coming to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event 2026, including limited-edition collectibles, new stores, brand collaborations, and rare Disney Parks finds.
body_text: Disney Announces New Shopping Experiences and Exclusive Merchandise Available to Fans at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event Brand July 21, 2026 14 min. read A first look at the curated stores, limited-edition collectibles, interactive activities, immersive experiences, and treasured keepsakes awaiting fans at this year’s event. Discover all-new stores including a D23 Marketplace Pin Store, Disney .YNSD by Mickey’s of Glendale, and The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds from Disney Parks. Today, Disney unveiled the full lineup of exclusive retail experiences and merchandise coming to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event presented by Visa, taking place August 14, 15, and 16, 2026, in Anaheim, California. Shopping will once again be a cornerstone of this year’s celebration, offering fans even more ways to engage with the stories, characters, and brands they love. Highlights include an all-new store from Mickey’s of Glendale; The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds from Disney Parks featuring props, artwork, and other unique treasures; limited-edition pins and collectibles; first-to-market brand collaborations and books; event-exclusive apparel; collectible vinyl records; and more. Spanning the Disney universe, these curated shopping destinations transform retail into an immersive part of the event, offering attendees access to exclusive releases, limited-edition merchandise, and unique treasures available only at the event, while creating new ways for fans to celebrate their connection to Disney. Reflecting the passion of Disney’s global fandom and the company’s unmatched ability to create cherished stories that span generations, D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event is one of the most highly anticipated events of the year and brings Disney’s unmatched ability to create meaningful connections to life through experiences designed especially for its most passionate fans. “Shopping is a fan-favorite part of the event, and this year our teams across Disney have come together to make it truly one of a kind,” said Michael Vargo, head of D23: The Official Disney Fan Club. “We can’t wait for fans to discover exclusive merchandise they won’t find anywhere else and take a piece of the magic home to enjoy long after the event ends.” Where To Shop D23 Marketplace Turn shopping dreams into reality at the D23 Marketplace , D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event’s central shopping hub. Offering a curated assortment of merchandise and must-have collectibles, fans visiting this location will find products celebrating some of Disney’s most beloved stories, characters, and franchises including a The Princess Diaries 25th Anniversary Collection, Star Wars and Marvel must-haves, global Disney Parks collections, the return of Disney Fine Art, and so much more. New at this year’s event is the D23 Marketplace Pin Store , a dedicated space featuring specially curated limited-edition and limited-release pins, with new designs released Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Completing the space is D23 Marketplace Photobooths and Medallions , home to personalized products and event exclusive medallions. Fans will be able to access the D23 Marketplace and D23 Marketplace Pin Store via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. The D23 Marketplace Photobooths and Medallions will be accessible via standby queue. All three locations will be cashless with card and contactless payment options accepted. D23 Marketplace will offer merchandise mobile checkout and the D23 Marketplace Pin Store will offer mobile order. Disney Store The official home of Disney retail is coming back to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event. At Disney Store , fans can shop uniquely imagined special-edition products and collections including Disney x Formula 1®, Blooms by Disney, and an assortment of Disney Store exclusive plush, as well as preview an all-new collaboration with SkinnyDip London. In addition to immersive shopping, the Disney Store booth will also offer interactive experiences including a life-size claw machine photo moment and a limited meet and greet with Disney Artists, featuring special sketch and signing opportunities which fans can pre-register for in the Disney D23 app from now to Friday, July 24, at 12 p.m. PT. Attendees who enter the main entrance of the Disney Store booth can also scan their badge to receive a free event-exclusive, limited-release tote bag or sticker featuring new character illustrations by Disney Artists, while supplies last. Fans will be able to access the Disney Store via standby queue. Shopping in the Disney Store booth will operate via QR Code where fans will scan to shop and have products delivered directly to their homes via DisneyStore.com. Starting Monday, August 17, at 8 a.m. PT, select merchandise sold during D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event at the D23 Marketplace and at the Disney Store booth will be available, while supplies last, at DisneyStore.com/d23-event/ . The Walt Disney Company Store Back for its second year at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event is The Walt Disney Company Store with two store locations in the Anaheim Convention Center. The first location, The Walt Disney Company Store, will exclusively host the official collection for D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event 2026 featuring brand collaborations from RSVLTS, Spirit Jersey, Nike, and Loungefly. In collaboration with the Walt Disney Archives, this store will introduce a collection inspired by Walt Disney’s iconic office in Burbank, Calif. — Suite 3H — where creativity and imagination came to life, a tribute to the visionary who started it all. This location will also feature collections showcasing some fan-favorite Disney animated Epic Rivals, iconic Walt Disney Studios landmarks, and an all-new collection from HARVEYS with one-of-a-kind designs developed through decommissioned seatbelts from Soarin’ Over California . The Walt Disney Company Pin Store will offer a large assortment of limited-edition pins, mystery boxes, and framed sets, perfect for pin collectors of all levels. For a preview of what’s to come at The Walt Disney Company Store, fans can visit D23.com . All merchandise is subject to availability with a daily pin catalogue launching each day: Friday , Saturday , and Sunday . Fans will be able to access The Walt Disney Company Store via virtual queue on Friday, August 14, with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. Saturday, August 15, and Sunday, August 16, will offer standby queue options only. The Walt Disney Company Store will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted alongside merchandise mobile checkout. Fans will be able to access The Walt Disney Company Pin Store via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. The Walt Disney Company Pin Store will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted, processed via mobile order. Physical registers will also be accessible and used for all pin frame sales. Mickey’s of Glendale Returning to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in 2026 with all-new Walt Disney Imagineering-inspired merchandise is Mickey’s of Glendale and Mickey’s of Glendale Pin Store . Developed especially for fans who love the artistry behind Disney’s Parks, attractions, and stories, Mickey’s of Glendale is the Walt Disney Imagineering campus store and houses exclusive merchandise assortments, pins, and more made by Walt Disney Imagineers. For a preview of what’s to come at Mickey’s of Glendale, fans can visit the Disney Parks Blog . For the collectors, Mickey’s of Glendale Pin Store will be a must-visit, launching a new assortment of limited-edition and exclusive pins Friday, Saturday, and Sunday . Fans will be able to access Mickey’s of Glendale via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. Mickey’s of Glendale will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted, alongside merchandise mobile checkout. Fans will be able to access the Mickey’s of Glendale Pin Store via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. Mickey’s of Glendale Pin Store will be cashless with card and contactless payment options, processed via mobile order. NEW: Disney .YNSD Debuting at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event 2026 is Disney .YNSD , a personal expression of the living design culture behind Walt Disney Imagineering across apparel, accessories, and beyond. Each lifestyle collection blends contemporary streetwear and layered storytelling, bridging style through thoughtful design, inviting fans to wear the magic and “ IMAGINE THE REST.” A preview of the collections that will be featured at Disney .YNSD can be found on the Disney Parks Blog . Fans will be able to access Disney .YNSD via virtual queue throughout the event, with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. Disney .YNSD will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted, processed via mobile order. Disney Studio Store Hollywood Step into the glamour of classic Hollywood at the Disney Studio Store Hollywood , home to apparel, accessories, and more inspired by the timeless magic of the iconic entertainment capital. Fans visiting this location can shop an all-new curated collection inspired by the El Capitan Theatre’s Centennial Celebration alongside limited-edition pins being released across all three event days: Friday, Saturday, and Sunday . Fans will be able to access the Disney Studio Store Hollywood via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. Disney Studio Store Hollywood will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted, alongside merchandise mobile checkout. Disney Publishing Books & Brew The hub for Disney best-selling books, reading-inspired products, and beyond is returning to D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event. Disney Publishing will house first-to-market books including must-read graphic novels, autobiographies, and guidebooks as well as collectible “bookcessories,” tarot card decks, book nook kits, and more. At this destination, fans can also enjoy a steady cadence of book signings with some fan-favorite authors as well as a “sip & shop” experience featuring a delicious new Disneyland Resort coffee blend from Joffrey’s Coffee & Tea Co. Marquee booth sponsor Penguin Random House will offer gift-with-purchase items, including art prints, sticker blind bags, Disney Editions tote bags, and more. Fans will be able to access Disney Publishing Books & Brew and make merchandise purchases via standard queue throughout the event. Disney Publishing Books & Brew will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted. Registration to attend in-booth signings will be conducted via virtual queue. NEW: The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds Debuting at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in 2026 is The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds on Sunday, August 16, for fans both at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event and globally online. Fans attending the event can preview items up for auction throughout the event weekend by visiting The Disney Experiences Auction Showroom. This is an immersive experience space via standby queue. Details for fans who want to bid will be communicated closer to the event. In addition, the show room will include a shopping experience that will allow fans a unique opportunity to shop rare and remarkable limited quantity props, artwork, and themed items found within Disney’s Parks, Resorts, and ships. A preview of items available during the event can be found here . Fans will be able to access The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds via virtual queue throughout the event with a standby queue option opening after all boarding groups have been redeemed. The Disney Experiences Auction – Rare and Remarkable Finds will be cashless with only card and contactless payment options accepted, alongside merchandise mobile checkout. title: Why Your Best Applicants Never Finish Applying
summary: Most hiring strategies focus on finding candidates. Far fewer focus on keeping them — and that's where districts are quietly losing the race.
body_text: The teacher shortage is well documented. According to the National Center for Education Statistics, 74% of public schools reported difficulty filling vacant teaching positions before the start of the 2024–25 school year — with "too few qualified candidates applying" cited as the top challenge nationwide. But there's a parallel problem that gets far less attention: the candidates who found your opening, clicked Apply, and quietly walked away before they ever finished. It's not visible in your data, and there's no way to know it happened. Those candidates simply move on — often to a district whose process got out of their way. Applications Lose Candidates at a Staggering Rate Across industries, application abandonment is extraordinarily high. According to Appcast , one of the most widely cited sources in recruitment research, 92% of candidates who click "Apply" never complete the application. The biggest culprits are length and friction. Appcast's Recruitment Marketing Benchmark Report found that applications taking under five minutes to complete convert at 12.47%. Applications taking over 15 minutes? Just 3.61%. That gap means roughly 2 in 3 candidates who started a long application would have applied if the application was easier to complete. For K-12 districts, this dynamic has added stakes. You're competing for a smaller pool of credentialed candidates, many of whom have multiple options. Every unnecessary step in your application process is a missed connection — a candidate who was ready to say yes, lost to friction before they ever finished. Nimble has spent years studying how teachers experience the K-12 hiring process, interviewing and surveying candidates across the country. The frustration around applications comes up constantly: "There are so many applications I started but didn't go back to finish because they were taking too long." "Filling out the same paperwork over and over is tedious after a bit — are they really reading through all this?" These weren't disinterested candidates. They were interested enough to start. The process is what lost them. Mobile Is No Longer a Nice-to-Have How candidates apply has also fundamentally shifted. Mobile applications now account for 67% of all job applications — a number that continues to climb each year. If your application wasn't designed for a phone — or if it requires downloading, filling out, and emailing back a PDF — you're not just creating friction. You're functionally invisible to a substantial portion of your candidate pool before they ever get started. Mobile-optimized application flows show significantly higher completion rates than desktop-focused ones. This isn't an emerging trend. It's the current reality of where candidates are. What "Streamlined" Actually Looks Like A better candidate experience isn't just about shortening a form. It's about removing every step that doesn't need to be there — and making the steps that remain as easy as possible. In practice, that means: Mobile-first design — not a desktop form that technically loads on a phone, but an experience built for one No redundant data entry — candidates shouldn't be retyping information they've already submitted elsewhere Clear, informative job postings — teachers consistently cite lack of school and role information as a reason they don't apply in the first place Visibility on the channels where teachers are searching — not just your district website Each of these is a lever. Districts that get them right don't just have better candidate experiences, they have more applicants. And in a market where qualified candidates are in short supply, volume matters. What Nimble Hire Does Differently Nimble Hire is a K-12-native applicant tracking system built around how teachers actually search and apply for jobs today. Its core features drive an average 95% increase in applicant volume for districts that use it. Statewide job board integration with quick apply. In states where Nimble powers the official educator job board, your open roles are automatically published on Discover — where teachers are already searching across the state. Candidates with an existing Nimble profile can quick-apply to your roles without ever leaving the platform — no new account, no starting over, no copy-pasting from a resume. It's the kind of one-tap experience that keeps interested candidates from dropping off before they finish. Automatic distribution to Indeed and ZipRecruiter. Your jobs are syndicated to the two largest job boards in the country without any extra work on your end. Plus, one-click social sharing extends your reach further across the channels where teachers spend their time. A mobile-first application experience. Nimble Hire was built mobile-first — not retrofitted for it. Candidates applying from their phone get the same clean, intuitive experience as those on a desktop, which means fewer abandoned applications and more completed ones. The Candidates Are Out There. Make It Easy for Them to Find You. In a tight hiring market, every unnecessary click is a candidate you almost had. The districts filling roles faster aren't working harder — they're removing the friction that drives qualified candidates away. title: Redefining Control in RNAi Manufacturing: How ECO Synthesis Enables True In-Process Analytics
body_text: High-resolution mass spectrometry can also confirm sequence identity after each addition, enabling stepwise verification of the growing oligonucleotide and strengthening overall process control. 2 . Early Error Detection and Material Preservation Even robust processes can encounter deviations. In enzymatic synthesis, over-extension or unintended additions can be detected rapidly through in-process mass analysis. For example, if a 10-mer extension unexpectedly yields measurable over-extended species, the issue is immediately apparent. The synthesis can be halted before additional high-value reagents are consumed. Root cause analysis can be conducted while the material remains recoverable. In traditional workflows, such failures may not become apparent until late-stage purification or final testing after substantial cost and time have already been invested. Early detection reduces waste, protects raw materials and improves overall process economics. 3 . Enabling a True Feedback Loop ECO Synthesis also supports quantitative process optimization. Using calibrated UV data and mass spectrometry, concentration and yield can be measured at each step. This transforms synthesis from a linear operation into a dynamic feedback-driven system. With cycle-by-cycle yield visibility, development teams can: Identify yield-limiting steps Adjust enzyme loading or reaction conditions Optimize extension efficiency Build predictive process models This aligns directly with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA’s) process analytical technology (PAT) framework, which emphasizes identification and control of critical sources of variability within a defined design space. A process is considered well understood when variability is characterized and product quality attributes can be reliably predicted. ECO Synthesis is inherently structured to support that objective. Direct sampling, stepwise verification and quantitative analytics create a data-rich environment in which variability is measured and managed.

title: Standard Motor Products, Inc. Releases First Quarter 2026 Results and Quarterly Dividend
summary: Standard Motor Products, Inc. (NYSE: SMP), a leading automotive parts manufacturer and distributor, reported today its consolidated financial results for the ...
body_text: Strong first quarter net sales of $451.2 million up, 9.1% from last year, with increases in all segments Adjusted Q1 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $0.82 and adjusted EBITDA of $44.5 million vs.$0.81 and $42.8 million last year, respectively Reaffirming full-year guidance of low to mid-single digit sales growth and adjusted EBITDA margin of 11% - 12% New York, NY, April 30, 2026 ......Standard Motor Products, Inc. (NYSE: SMP), a leading automotive parts manufacturer and distributor, reported today its consolidated financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. Net sales for the first quarter of 2026 were $451.2 million, compared to consolidated net sales of $413.4 million during the same quarter in 2025. Earnings from continuing operations for the first quarter of 2026 were $18.3 million or $0.81 per diluted share, compared to earnings of $13.7 million or $0.61 per diluted share in the first quarter of 2025. Excluding non-operational gains and losses identified on the attached reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP measures, earnings from continuing operations for the first quarter of 2026 were $18.6 million or $0.82 per diluted share, compared to $18.0 million or $0.81 per diluted share in the first quarter of 2025. Mr. Eric Sills, Standard Motor Products’ Chairman and Chief Executive Officer stated, “We are quite pleased with our performance in the first quarter. Sales for the quarter increased 9.1%, with all segments performing well, reflecting a continuation of the steady customer demand experienced throughout last year. First Quarter Highlights: North American Aftermarket Segments Vehicle Control sales increased 11.2% in the first quarter, largely on the strength of customer pipeline orders as they expand assortments to capture DIFM share. We continue to experience favorable demand, as evidenced by strong customer POS and reflective of the non-discretionary nature of our products. We also saw a nominal lift from pass-through tariff pricing. Temperature Control sales increased a modest 0.7%, against last year’s record first quarter, when sales were up 24%. As we enter our second quarter, we still have preseason orders left to ship as customers prepare for the upcoming summer selling season. While we are off to a strong start, including favorable customer POS, ultimately this seasonal business will be determined by the strength of the summer months. Nissens Nissens sales increased 12.4% to $74.4 million, driven by a stronger currency conversion. Our sales grew 2.7% in local currency against a difficult comparison. 2025 was marked by robust first half customer orders, while this year has returned to a more normal cadence. As we are now into our second year of ownership, we begin to look towards growth related to recently launched product categories and remain excited about the multitude of opportunities ahead. Engineered Solutions Sales in the Engineered Solutions segment showed solid growth of 12.6% over last year’s soft first quarter as demand continues to recover. Sales growth was aided by recovery in commercial vehicle and power sports end-markets, driven by ordering patterns with certain customers. Profitability & Balance Sheet Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter increased to $44.5 million, up from $42.8 million last year, driven by solid performance across our North American Aftermarket segments. Nissens EBITDA was negatively impacted by currency transaction losses on sourcing this quarter, and Engineered Solutions experienced temporary unfavorable manufacturing variances as well as certain inflationary headwinds. From a balance sheet perspective, our cash flows and borrowings were in line with expectations. Total net debt at quarter-end stood at $599.4 million, primarily reflecting an increase over yearend due to seasonal working capital build as sales ramp-up each year during the first quarter. Importantly, our inventory declined slightly in the quarter as we were well prepared for sales orders coming into the year. Our net debt leverage increased modestly to 3.0x due to seasonal working capital build, and we continue to target reducing net debt levels to 2.0x adjusted EBITDA by the end of 2026. 2026 Guidance Update Our outlook for the full year of 2026 reaffirms our expectation that sales growth will be in the low to mid-single digit range driven by ongoing tailwinds for professional grade non-discretionary products in the North American aftermarket, continuing momentum in our European business, and an ongoing recovery in Engineered Solutions, offset by a lapping of both tariff pricing and the benefits of stronger currency conversion. Further, we expect Adjusted EBITDA will be in a range of 11% -12%, aided by initiatives we have underway to drive ongoing profitability gains, partially offset by margin compression attributable to passing through tariffs at cost, which began in the second half of 2025. Note that our guidance excludes the impact of ongoing changes in the tariff landscape, or any significant inflationary impact from the conflict in the Middle East. We intend to address these pressures with our usual combination of cost savings and pricing programs. Dividends The Board of Directors has approved payment of a quarterly dividend of 33 cents per share on the common stock outstanding, which will be paid on June 1, 2026, to stockholders of record on May 15, 2026. Closing Remarks In closing, Mr. Sills commented, “We are off to a strong start to 2026 and are encouraged by the overall trends across our segments. While the near-term macroeconomic and tariff-related volatility persists, we continue to find ways to perform well in a challenging environment, and leverage our market leadership and the nondiscretionary nature of our products. We are excited about our global opportunities to drive growth and profitability and look forward to another year to deliver value to all our shareholders. I would like to thank our employees for their hard work and commitment to our continued success.” View Consolidated Financial Statements Conference Call Standard Motor Products, Inc. will hold a conference call at 11:00 AM, Eastern Time, on Thursday, April 30, 2026. This call will be webcast and can be accessed on our website at www.smpcorp.com and clicking on the SMP Q1'26 Earnings Call Webcast link. On the base plans, it automatically records your meetings, transcribes them, and syncs everything to your CRM. It also labels key parts of each conversation, like pricing, objections, or next steps, so you can jump straight to them. You can also search transcripts by keyword, track speaker sentiment, and draft follow-up emails. But most of Avoma’s dedicated coaching tools sit behind the Conversation Intelligence add-on. This requires a separate purchase on top of your existing plan. With it, you get AI scorecards, automatic call scoring, and a live AI assistant that suggests responses when reps hit an objection. “Probably missing some of the more advanced coaching, insight, [and] roll up metrics in other more expensive solutions. If you don’t need those, this is a great tool.” — G2 Key features of Avoma Live answer cards with real-time guidance during calls AI scorecards built around frameworks like MEDDIC and BANT Coaching insights tied to CRM data and pipeline outcomes All-in-one scheduler, agenda builder, and call summaries Curated call playlists for self-paced coaching Avoma pricing Sales teams can choose from three Avoma plans: Startup: $19 per user per month for up to 25 users, automatic video recording and transcription, AI summary notes with templates like MEDDIC, SPICED, and SPIN, speaker insights covering talk-time and filler words, and automatic note sync to your CRM Organization: $29 per user per month for up to 100 users, custom meeting topics, custom note templates, AI-translated transcripts and meeting notes in 70+ languages, a shared customer success manager, and AI-curated call playlists for team coaching Enterprise: $39 per user per month with a 10-user minimum, unlimited historical analytics, a designated customer success manager, and SSO/HIPAA compliance For deeper call scoring and coaching recommendations, Avoma offers a conversation intelligence add-on for $29 per user per month. 3. Dialpad Sell: Best sales call coaching software for real-time in-call coaching Pros Live Coach Cards trigger based on keywords AI Playbooks track methodology adherence in real time Live sentiment analysis flags calls going sideways HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 compliant Cons Advanced AI features require a higher tier Dialpad Sell is separate from Connect, Dialpad’s calling product Some users report app lag and glitches Contracts auto-renew, with penalties if you downgrade mid-term Dialpad Sell is a sales phone system that combines business calling with AI coaching and real-time voice analytics. Its base plan includes the basics for recording and reviewing your calls, including: Call recording and transcription Call listening tools like silent monitoring, whisper coaching, and barge-in Custom vocabulary for accurate transcription AI-flagged call moments Sales call coaching is still pretty hands-on at this tier. You’re the one reviewing calls, catching mistakes, and checking whether reps followed your sales process. You can add AI agents for coaching, playbooks, and live battlecards. But you’d have to upgrade to Advanced or Premium. Key features of Dialpad Sell Live coach cards based on call keywords AI Playbooks tracking BANT or SPIN milestones Live sentiment dashboard across team calls Scorecard leaderboards for talk ratio and adherence AI call summaries built into the dialer Dialpad Sell pricing Here’s a quick breakdown of Dialpad Sell’s pricing plans: Essentials: $39 per user per month for call recording and transcription, live call monitoring with whisper and barge, coaching team setup, custom vocabulary, and AI-generated call summaries that sync to your CRM Advanced: $95 per user per month for real-time coaching prompts that surface objection-handling guidance during calls, and flagging and logging key call moments directly to your CRM Premium: $150 per user per month for AI-graded scorecards based on your sales methodology, automated tracking of rep adherence to sales playbooks, and screen recording 4. Aircall: Best for sales call centers Pros Power Dialer for high-volume outbound calling Real-time AI coaching during live calls Integrates with 200+ tools, including HubSpot and Salesforce Local numbers in over 100 countries Cons AI features cost extra, even on the base plan Three-user minimum on starter and mid-tier plans Recordings are only kept for a year unless you upgrade Deeper analytics require a separate $15 add-on Aircall is a cloud-based phone system for sales teams that handle high call volume . Its base plan includes call recording, call transcription, conversation history, and call tags. Upgrade to the Professional plan, and you’ll also get call whispering, live monitoring, and more advanced analytics. But neither plan includes automated call summaries, sentiment analysis, or topic tracking. To add these AI coaching features, you’ll need to buy the $9 AI Assist add-on. Want custom scorecards, live coaching prompts, and real-time AI guidance during calls? That requires AI Assist Pro, a higher-level add-on that costs $49 per user per month. Here’s what real-life users think about Aircall’s pricing structure: “The core features are generally fine, but many useful integrations and more advanced analytics are only available as paid add-ons, which can add up.” — G2 Key features of Aircall Live prompts based on what’s said on the call Playbook tracking with an automated adherence score One-click voicemail drops for outbound calls CRM screen pop showing recent customer history 250+ app integrations Aircall pricing Aircall offers three pricing plans, depending on your team’s size and needs: Essentials: $30 per user per month for call recording and transcription, standard analytics, and the ability to comment on and tag calls for team review, with a minimum of three users Professional: $50 per user per month for call whispering and monitoring, mandatory call tagging, live team monitoring, advanced analytics, and Salesforce CTI integration, with a minimum of three users Custom: Contact sales for pricing for unlimited call recording access and unlimited analytics data, with a minimum of 25 users You can also add features like call scoring and talk-to-listen ratios for $9 per user per month. Advanced tools such as live coaching prompts are available as a premium add-on for $49 per user per month. 5. Gong: Best for enterprise B2B sales and RevOps teams Pros Covers calls, emails, and meetings in one platform Deal intelligence ties coaching to pipeline health and forecasts Benchmarks reps against your top performers Cons No public pricing, and users say it gets expensive Multi-year contracts with price hikes at renewal More than most teams need for basic call review Gong is a category leader in conversation intelligence for enterprise sales teams. It records and uses AI to analyze every call , email, and video conversation across your organization. For sales coaching, Gong offers a few key tools: Scorecards to rate reps on specific behaviors or compliance points Topic tracking to see how much time reps spend on pricing, discovery, or product demos Winning behavior identification that pulls patterns from your top performers, so the rest of the team has something to follow Smart follow-up reminders that automatically flag a missed action item Deal health tracking that flags signals like declining engagement or competitor mentions None of this happens live, though. Every call has to be processed before Gong surfaces coaching insights, and that alone can take a few minutes to a few hours. A rep stuck on an objection mid-call won’t get any guidance until then. See for yourself: “My main complaints are the time it takes for calls to analyze, especially when they are over 45 minutes in length. Sometimes for last-minute meetings, they do not get captured by Gong and require me to manually upload the call.” — G2 Key features of Gong Revenue Graph linking calls, emails, and meetings Smart Trackers that catch themes without exact keywords Pattern matching top reps against the rest of the team Risk alerts for single-threaded deals or missed follow-ups Progress tracking over 30, 60, or 90 days Gong pricing Pricing for Gong isn’t publicly available, but some third-party sources estimate a platform fee of $5,000 to $50,000 per year, plus roughly $1,300 to $1,600 per user annually. You’ll need to contact Gong’s sales team directly to get a personalized quote for your business. Chorus by ZoomInfo: Best for methodology-driven sales coaching Pros Scorecards tied to frameworks like BANT Flags when a deal advances or stalls Auto-surfaces top calls for coaching Cons Requires a ZoomInfo contract No transparent pricing Chorus by ZoomInfo records and scores sales calls against your team’s sales process. You set the criteria, such as BANT or MEDDICC, and Chorus checks every call against them. It does that by using AI topic tracking to identify where key discussions happen during each call. It also combines those insights with emails and CRM activity to surface broader deal risks across your pipeline. However, Chorus isn’t sold as a standalone product. You’ll need a ZoomInfo account to buy and manage it, and there’s no public pricing. That makes it a less straightforward option than some of the other tools on this list. Key features of Chorus ZoomInfo data on company size, revenue, and intent signals Automatic scoring against your sales methodology Momentum insights that flag stalling deals Deal board showing pipeline risk across accounts Smart playlists built from top-performing calls Chorus pricing Chorus pricing isn’t publicly available. However, you can try it as a part of a broader ZoomInfo contract. ZoomInfo offers a seven-day free trial plus lite tier with monthly credits. For exact pricing, you’ll need to contact their sales team directly for a custom quote. 7. Balto — Best for live compliance and talk-track adherence Pros Real-time prompts guide reps through each call Built-in compliance monitoring Playbooks update automatically as messaging changes Cons Lacks deep post-call analytics No transparent pricing Better suited for call centers than consultative sales Balto is AI sales coaching software built around real-time compliance and script adherence. It lets managers build playbooks with the scripts and compliance steps reps need to follow. Balto then listens to every live call and checks the conversation against it. When it detects an objection or required compliance step, it displays the next recommended response on the rep’s screen. It also checks whether reps complete required compliance steps during the call. For example, if a rep tells a customer something is guaranteed when it isn’t, Balto displays a real-time prompt so they can correct it before the call ends. Just know that Balto is built primarily for live call guidance. It doesn’t offer the deal-level and pipeline tracking that tools like Gong or Chorus provide. It also has no roleplay or practice tools to help reps prepare before a call. Some users also find the live prompts too rigid or distracting during fast-moving conversations: “While Balto’s scripts and prompts are helpful, they can sometimes feel rigid, leaving less room for flexibility when I want to personalize interactions more. It would be great if there were more options for customizing the suggestions to better match my own style.” — G2 Key features of Balto Real-time prompts that update as the call happens Intent recognition beyond keyword matching Compliance alerts for missing disclosures Automatic scoring that feeds straight into live prompts Balto pricing Balto uses a per-user pricing model where your monthly cost depends on how many seats you need and the overall length of your contract. However, the company doesn’t publicly share its pricing. Contact their sales team directly for a quote tailored to your business. 8. Mindtickle: Best for enterprise teams with a formal sales readiness program Pros Scores rep skills and routes training automatically AI roleplay for practicing objections Gamified training with badges and leaderboards Custom certification paths with built-in manager grading Cons Implementation can take weeks Often needs a dedicated admin No live call listening Some users report slow loading times with heavy content Mindtickle is a sales enablement platform for large enterprise teams. It combines call reviews, training, AI roleplays, and sales content in one platform. At the center of the platform is the Sales Readiness Index, which scores how prepared each rep is to sell and identifies skill gaps across the team. Based on those results, managers can assign targeted training and AI roleplay sessions. Reps then practice conversations with AI buyers and receive feedback after each session. Keep in mind that if you’re mainly looking to review calls and give reps quick feedback, its training modules can feel like overkill. “…it can sometimes feel overly complex when you just need quick answers or fast updates. Pulling specific readiness or certification insights isn’t always as intuitive as it could be.” — G2 Key features of Mindtickle Sales Readiness Index that scores reps across quizzes, training, and calls Automatic training assignments when the platform flags a skill gap AI roleplay with a buyer that adapts to what a rep says Certification paths with manager grading built in Salesforce sync that ties training data to win rates Mindtickle pricing Mindtickle doesn’t list its prices online. You’ll need to contact their sales team directly for a quote. 9. Allego — Best for AI roleplay and pre-call practice Pros AI roleplay with realistic sales conversations Automatic scoring and feedback for practice sessions FINRA, SEC, and FDA certifications for regulated industries Cons Some users report that the roleplay can still feel robotic Includes training tools smaller teams may not need No public pricing or free trial Allego is a sales enablement platform. It gives reps AI roleplay to build skills and lets managers review calls and coach asynchronously. Its core sales AI feature is the Live Dialog Simulator. This allows reps to practice against AI buyers that respond in real time across 32 languages and 71 voices and accents. Allego also scores recorded calls automatically to identify skill gaps. Managers can then leave text or audio feedback at specific moments in the conversation. Between coaching sessions, it also delivers short quizzes and drills to reinforce the skills. However, Allego is built to improve individual sales reps rather than track deal performance. It can score practice sessions and recorded calls, but its pipeline insights are fairly limited. Some users also report that the platform can be hard to get used to at first. Take a look: “The potential downside is that it takes time for beginners to get fully comfortable with the features. For instance, advanced tools like AI coaching have a lot of resources to dedicate [to] learning but still have initial challenges.” — G2 Key features of Allego Unscripted AI roleplay through the Live Dialog Simulator Support for 32 languages and 71 voices and accents Automatic practice assignments when the AI flags a skill gap Timestamped video comments for async coaching Allego pricing Allego uses a per-user pricing model that gets cheaper if you add more seats or sign a longer contract. However, it doesn’t mention its pricing publicly, so you’ll need to contact their sales team for a custom quote. 10. Jiminny: Best for international and globally distributed sales teams Pros Records and transcribes in 60+ languages GDPR and SOC II compliant, with dedicated EU and US servers Custom visibility rules for call confidentiality Automatically scores calls against your own rulebook Cons Less pipeline forecasting than Gong or Chorus Some users report wanting more advanced analytics Some users report occasional AI typos with technical jargon Jiminny is a conversation intelligence platform that supports sales coaching across 60+ languages. It’s well-suited to international teams, with EU data hosting, GDPR support, and controls over who can access call recordings. The tool records and transcribes calls, video meetings, and emails, then syncs everything to your CRM. Managers can search those conversations with plain-language AI prompts. It also tracks coaching metrics like talk-to-listen ratio and lets managers save key moments to shared call libraries. However, Jiminny is built around reviewing conversations rather than practicing them beforehand. It doesn’t include AI roleplay for pre-call coaching. And as with many AI tools at this stage, the transcripts can be less accurate when calls include too much technical jargon or strong accents.Here’s what one reviewer said: “Jiminny gives some AI-generated insights or summaries that may need consistent manual review to make sense or be accurate. Some transcription errors occur, and this may alter the entire experience.” — G2 Key features of Jiminny AI call recording and transcription in 60+ languages Automatic CRM field-filling for budget, timeline, and deal details Multi-call summaries for a full view of each deal Automatic scoring against your own sales playbook Automatic alerts when a rep misses a key talking point Jiminny pricing Jiminny uses custom pricing, depending on the size of your team. You’ll need to book a demo to get a quote tailored to your business. Which sales call coaching software is right for your team size? There is no single best sales call coaching software. The right choice depends on your team size and the type of coaching or sales training you need. Here’s how to think about it: Under 25 reps: Start with Quo. Coaching features are built into your phone plan, so you don’t have to buy and manage a separate platform. If your team does most of its selling over video rather than phone calls, Avoma is worth considering alongside it. 25–100 reps: As your team requires more complicated features, consider Dialpad Sell, Aircall, or Jiminny. These tools save time with automated scorecards, coaching insights, and live guidance during calls. 100–200 reps: Gong and Chorus make more sense at this stage. They help you spot patterns across your team’s conversations, understand why deals are won or lost, and track win rates. If your reps must follow strict scripts or specific processes, consider Balto. 200+ reps: Use Mindtickle or Allego to get a platform for sales coaching, roleplay, and content management. Many enterprise teams also use Gong to see how conversations affect pipeline and revenue. 7 Features you should look for in sales call coaching software Finding the right sales coaching software can be exhausting because there are so many tools out there. This list will help you cut through the noise and find the right fit for your team. AI call transcription and summaries. Listening to every call takes too much time for busy managers. AI transcripts and summaries let you review a whole call quickly. Depending on the platform, you can also search for key phrases to find what you need A searchable call library. Your best rep’s calls are your best training tools. Every recorded call should be easy to find by rep, date, or keyword. Some sales coaching tools let you save short clips and organize them into playlists. Others keep things simple with a searchable list of recordings. The right choice depends on your team size. Sentiment and intent detection. Some tools flag frustrated callers, buying intent, or other signals that are important to you. This is useful for managers who want to prioritize which calls to review first. Detailed call analytics . Call volume only tells you how busy your team is. Look for tools that also track call duration distribution, peak activity times, and per-rep performance over time. CRM integration. Your coaching software must share data with your CRM automatically. Otherwise, you and your reps have to input call notes manually every time. This wastes time and creates more errors. Security and data compliance. Sales coaching software stores private customer call recordings and transcripts. Look for SOC II certification, data retention controls, and encryption. Depending on your location, you may also need your tool to be compliant with CCPA, GDPR, or other regulations. Transparent pricing. Many enterprise software companies require you to speak with sales before they reveal their pricing. For small teams, that can make it harder to compare tools and find one that fits their budget. Prioritize vendors that publish clear pricing tiers or at least a starting price on their website so you can make a faster decision. Quo: Practical sales call coaching without the complexity Every tool on this list gives you a different way to review your team’s calls. Some focus on deal intelligence. Others focus on live compliance or full enablement suites. If you’re a small or growing team that wants a practical way to surface coachable moments and help reps close more, Quo is the best fit. Quo gives you call recordings, AI transcripts, and AI call tags in one platform. That means you can spot a pattern without digging through hours of audio. With Claude connected, you can go even further and ask questions across your entire call history whenever you need to. Your next coaching opportunity is probably sitting in a call you’ve not had time to review. Start your seven-day free trial and let Quo find it for you. FAQs What is sales call coaching software? Sales call coaching software automatically records and transcribes your sales conversations. It uses AI to analyze your calls for instant coaching insights like poor objection handling or competitor mentions. This helps you coach your entire team at scale without listening to every single recording. It also helps your reps improve with feedback based on real conversations instead of roleplay scenarios. What’s the difference between conversation intelligence and sales coaching software? Conversation intelligence is the underlying capability. It’s the ability to capture, transcribe, and analyze sales conversations to surface patterns and insights. Sales coaching software is a tool that uses conversation intelligence to help managers coach reps, track performance, and improve close rates. How much does sales call coaching software cost? Sales call coaching software starts at around $15 per user per month and can exceed $150 per user per month for more advanced platforms. Costs vary based on your team size and the coaching, conversation intelligence, and AI features you need. Some providers don’t publicly disclose their pricing and require you to contact their sales team for a quote. Does sales call coaching software work for remote teams? Yes. Sales call coaching software works particularly well for remote and distributed teams. It lets managers review calls and provide feedback without having to schedule live coaching sessions. Reps can then review that feedback and improve independently. Can I use AI to coach sales calls without a dedicated platform? Yes. If your business phone system already records and transcribes calls, you may not need a dedicated call coaching platform. You can connect those transcripts to AI models like Claude and ChatGPT. They then review your conversations and help you spot areas for improvement. For example, Quo’s Claude integration lets you ask questions across your entire call history. Use it to learn: – Which objections come up most often? – Which reps ask the best discovery questions? – Where do deals tend to stall? What is the best sales coaching software? The best sales coaching software depends on your business size and needs. Quo is the best business phone system for sales teams that rely heavily on phone calls. Avoma is ideal for mid-market teams that mainly sell over video meetings. Dialpad Sell is better if you need real-time, in-call coaching prompts. Larger businesses should consider Gong for enterprise-level revenue intelligence. Is AI sales coaching software worth it? AI sales coaching software is worth it if your goal is to save time and automate data collection. It cuts call-review time from hours to minutes and gives reps instant feedback after they hang up. However, it won’t work if you expect the software to do the actual coaching for you. To get the best results, you must leverage the insights you gain from the tool to have meaningful, practical sales conversations with your team.

title: Looking Back at Superb AI’s 2025
summary: If 2024 was a year of “preparing for AI adoption,” 2025 was the year when “AI began powering the physical world.” As generative AI surged, adoption quickly move
body_text: Team Looking Back at Superb AI’s 2025 Hyun Kim Co-Founder & CEO | 2025/12/23 | 10 min read Linkedin X(twitter) If 2024 was a year of “preparing for AI adoption,” 2025 was the year when “AI began powering the physical world.” As generative AI surged, adoption quickly moved beyond digital environments and into real industrial sites. Growth: Breakout Growth Backed by Market Confidence Despite global and domestic economic uncertainty, 2025 was the year Superb AI’s enterprise value was clearly validated. With an eye on a 2026 IPO, we secured both a stable financial foundation and strong momentum for rapid growth. 2x YoY Growth: In 2025, our order volume more than doubled from the previous year, expanding our real market share. With technology built for immediate real-world deployment, we are lowering the barrier to adopting vision AI in industrial environments. “ZERO,” an Industry-Tailored Foundation Model: We launched ZERO, a vision foundation model that requires no pre-training . Using only text or image prompts, it can instantly recognize new defect types or objects—reducing AI adoption timelines in industrial sites from months to days. Vision AI Agent, “Superb AI Video Analytics”: We launched an agentic solution that goes beyond passive CCTV monitoring—AI proactively understands situations and generates reports. It enables natural-language search for the exact scenes you need and detects anomalies in advance. Proven Global Technical Leadership: Runner-Up and 4th place at CVPR 2025 : We ranked second and fourth across two challenges at CVPR, the world’s largest computer vision conference. Superb AI was the only Korean company among the top-ranked teams—competing head-to-head with leading AI players from China and other global powerhouses—demonstrating global competitiveness through an industry-tailored strategy without relying on costly, massive-scale infrastructure. AWS Generative AI Competency: We received official recognition for our capabilities in image similarity search and training-image generation—significantly improving customers’ productivity in AI development. National Certifications and Awards: We were named a Top 5 “AI Foundation Model” company by Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT, won Japan’s AI Market AWARD 2025 in the image recognition category, and earned a Grade 1 GS certification for Superb Platform. We also completed patent registrations in Korea, the U.S., and Japan for “data-centric AI” and “no-code AI” technologies, bringing our global patent portfolio to 63. In addition, we were selected as the visual intelligence company within the Korean Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy’s “K-Humanoid Alliance,” and recognized as an “Outstanding Super Gap Startup” at Seoul Startup Hub’s “2(To)gether” performance sharing event—further strengthening our technical leadership at home and abroad. 3. Impact: Finding Answers in the Field In 2025, Superb AI’s technology took root across real-world industrial sites—from manufacturing and infrastructure to health care and sports—driving measurable change where it matters most. 🏭 CS WIND : Our AI was deployed in the manufacturing process of the world’s No. 1 wind tower producer, achieving 99.9% accuracy in material identification and leading digital transformation in heavy industries. ✈️ Incheon International Airport : Our AI analyzed video feeds from thousands of cameras in real time to measure crowd density and optimize passenger flow and security operations. ⚾ KT Wiz Park : We built Korea’s first AI smart stadium —analyzing crowd congestion in real time and creating a safer spectator environment. 🏥 Ajou University Dental Hospital: We helped drive clinical innovation by developing an AI model that diagnoses cavities using only smartphone-captured images— in just three weeks . 👕 Yakjin Trading & Pocheon Ildong Makgeolli : We reduced apparel inventory auditing time to the two-second range and automated makgeolli quality inspection with AI—maximizing efficiency across diverse industries. 2025 was the year Superb AI proved the potential of “physical AI.” In 2026, as a vision AI expert building the “eyes of industry,” we will lead the global AI market with even greater responsibility and innovation. title: OpenAI Codex with Ollama
summary: Open models can be used with OpenAI's Codex CLI through Ollama. Codex can read, modify, and execute code in your working directory using models such as gpt-oss:20b, gpt-oss:120b, or other open-weight alternatives.
body_text: Open models can be used with OpenAI’s Codex CLI through Ollama. Codex can read, modify, and execute code in your working directory using models such as gpt-oss:20b , gpt-oss:120b , or other open-weight alternatives. Get started Install Codex CLI: npm install -g @openai/codex Start Codex with the --oss flag: codex --oss By default, Codex will use the local gpt-oss:20b model. Note: Codex requires a large context window. We recommend at least 32K tokens. See the documentation for how to adjust context length in Ollama. Changing models You can switch to a different model using the -m flag: codex --oss -m gpt-oss:120b Cloud models All models on Ollama Cloud work with Codex. codex --oss -m gpt-oss:120b-cloud Learn more For more detailed setup instructions and configuration options, see the Codex integration guide .

title: Dynamic Threshold Management: How to Adapt Rules as the Company Grows
summary: See how to adapt dynamic approval threshold rules as your company grows, with App Versioning in Jestor.
body_text: Scalable dynamic thresholds are approval rules that adjust as the company grows, with no need to rebuild the process from scratch at every new stage. Why a threshold that worked before stops working A threshold rule created for a 20-person company is rarely the same one that makes sense at 100 — request volume grows, new roles appear, and cost-center structure becomes more complex. Without revision, the old threshold becomes a bottleneck. How to adapt thresholds without losing history Ideally, every adjustment to a threshold rule gets documented — what changed, when, and why — so the company understands the process's evolution, instead of simply overwriting the old rule. Yes, previous versions can be restored when needed. Does this work well for early-stage companies too? Yes, the structure can start simple and grow as needed. Learn more at jestor.com.
